points.text: No experiment manipulates temporal feature variation with other factors fixed; causal augmentation claim untested
Main evidence uses training-set composite metrics only
Label-free prediction agreement on test/corrupted data cannot measure generalization
Overclaiming wording such as "direct evidence", "establish", "rigorous statistical evidence"
Abstract says random labels but experiments use 40% noisy labels
"Across datasets and architectures" claim unsupported; main text only ResNet-20/CIFAR-10
Theorem 1 TV term uncomputed and possibly trivial; no delta, window or TV values reported
Theorem 2 is merely Markov's inequality
NTK argument comparing mixed-parameter loss to frozen-shallow trajectory does not follow
Spherical null for SGD-noise anisotropy is weak
Claimed correlation with consistency and alignment with feature dynamics have no supporting analysis
Bootstrap B, N, d and multiplicity handling not stated
"Not a convergence artifact" argument expected under slow drift; LR schedule unreported
No seeds or repeated runs anywhere
Welch's t-test on per-sample bounded consistency values with unstated n is inappropriate
Identical p-values reported for Depth 1 and Depth 3
Duplicate heading, appendix lettering collisions, ambiguous cross-references, overloaded notation d
"3-4% accuracy drop" is actually relative error increase
Causal augmentation claim untested; results equally explained by slow drift and insensitive classifier
Reinit/freeze interventions are single-run with differences within seed noise
Freeze experiment removes trainable capacity as well as drift, confounded
No experiment relates consistency window length to generalization gap across runs
Consistency is implied by high training accuracy and measured mostly on training set
No chance or null baseline for consistency levels
Agreement under distribution shift counts both-wrong cases; cannot show augmentation effectiveness
Convergence-artifact rebuttal does not rule out slow drift; LR schedule not given
Spherical covariance null is a straw man; anisotropy expected from Jacobian
Claimed anisotropy-consistency correlation and alignment with feature dynamics never shown
Fig. 8 setup, bootstrap B, N, d unstated; no multiple-testing correction
"Across datasets and architectures" unsupported; architectures for other datasets not stated
SVHN and STL-10 use Adam, so SGD-noise narrative does not apply
No seeds, repeated runs or error bars
Welch's t-test on non-independent per-sample values; n and effect size missing
NTK forgetting argument is logically flawed; mixed point not on frozen trajectory
ResNet-20 at lr 0.1 is not in lazy regime, so NTK contrast uninformative
Duplicate heading typo, appendix letter collisions, ambiguous references, overloaded d, notation inconsistency
"3-4% accuracy drop" misreports relative error increase as accuracy drop
Identical p-values for Depth 1 and Depth 3 in Table 1, likely copy error
Noisy-label experiment uses 40% noise, not random labels as claimed
Stability shows classifier insensitivity, not that exposure to varied features regularized deep layers
Assumption that time-window features mimic unseen inputs' feature distribution is unchecked
Agreement used as stand-in for generalization; composite accuracy on test/OOD missing
Noisy-label collapse could reflect memorization instability; no control separating explanations
Abstract says random labels while experiment randomizes 40% of labels
Headline evidence only ResNet-20/CIFAR-10; no transformer or non-residual network
No practical use of the window shown, e.g., predicting gap or checkpoint selection
No limitations section
Closest prior work (stitching, SVCCA, mode connectivity, SWA) not cited or differentiated
Simpler explanation (shallow layers converge early, deep adapt) never engaged
SGD-noise anisotropy result is already well established, not novel
SDE background mis-sourced and lacks learning-rate factor
Theorem 1 likely vacuous since TV equals 1 between singular measures; no computed values
Theorem 2 is Markov's inequality
NTK foil is not a meaningful comparator; flawed and lazy regime irrelevant
Zhang et al. (2016) citation wording is loose
Overclaiming wording ("direct evidence", "establish", "rigorous") for observational results
Abstract says random labels but section 5 uses 40% randomized labels
Fig. 3 caption reference network differs from definition; definitions mention y but unused
Duplicate headings, inconsistent appendix lettering, ambiguous references, overloaded d
Key reinit/freeze controls buried in appendix without table or error bars
Theory is conceptual only; no delta, window or TV value computed yet presented as contribution
No summary table across datasets and architectures; evidence qualitative
Seeds and variability of curves not shown
Typos and figure captions omitting model and dataset
Not prescriptive; no new training algorithm derived to improve generalization
Source code not released, limiting reproducibility
Limited experimental scope; unclear if holds on bigger datasets, architectures, other domains
Effect of hyperparameter selection on phenomena not studied
No comparison or discussion with Tunnel Effect and related representation-dynamics work
TV bound is conceptual and not computable; MMD/Wasserstein surrogates untested
Evidence limited to small/mid-scale datasets; no ImageNet or large transformers
BatchNorm handling in composite networks not described, may confound results
Optimizer sensitivity not analyzed; anisotropy shown only for SGD though Adam used
Unclear difference from prior stitching/ensembling like SWA, SWAG, temporal ensembling
Many formatting/presentation errors: terminology, undefined abbreviations, citations, duplicate section, wrong references
Claim that SGD stochasticity makes features a distribution is questionable for single network
Section 4 experiments on training set may be trivial convergence artifacts; test set needed
Relation of NTK discussion to main claim unclear

P.summary: Causal augmentation claim untested; alternative explanations (insensitive classifier, early convergence) not ruled out
Evidence on training set; consistency implied by training accuracy
Prediction agreement used as proxy for generalization
Overclaiming wording
Random labels claim vs 40% noisy labels
Limited architectures/datasets; "across datasets and architectures" overstated
Theorem 1 uncomputed, possibly vacuous, conceptual only
Theorem 2 is Markov's inequality
NTK argument logically flawed
NTK comparison not meaningful for the main claim
Spherical null for anisotropy is weak
Claimed correlation/alignment of SGD noise unsupported
Statistical test details and multiplicity not reported
Convergence-artifact rebuttal weak; LR schedule unreported
No seeds, repeated runs or error bars
Welch's t-test on per-sample values inappropriate
Identical p-values for Depth 1 and 3
Formatting, headings, appendix numbering, notation, typos
"3-4% accuracy drop" misreported
Reinit/freeze interventions single-run, within noise
Freeze experiment confounded by capacity removal
No relation of window length to generalization gap across runs
No null baseline for consistency
Adam used on some datasets; SGD narrative inapplicable
Ergodicity assumption about time-window features unchecked
Noisy-label collapse may reflect memorization; no control
No practical use or prescriptive application shown
No limitations section
Missing related work on stitching, SVCCA, mode connectivity, SWA
SGD-noise anisotropy not novel
SDE background mis-sourced
Loose citation wording for Zhang et al.
Fig. 3 caption inconsistent with definitions
Key controls buried in appendix
No summary table across datasets

Q.summary: Not prescriptive; no improved training algorithm
Missing discussion of Tunnel Effect works
TV bound not computable; surrogates untested
BatchNorm handling in composites not described
Optimizer sensitivity; anisotropy only for SGD despite Adam
Training-set results may be convergence artifacts
